summary: Codebase is structurally sound with 0 TypeScript errors and 423 passing tests, but 7 of 15 server action files lack unit tests and repositories.ts (33 functions) has no error handling.
findings: ✅ Tests: 423 passed across 29 unit test files
✅ 'use server' correctness: all non-async exports in server action files are interface/type exports — no non-async function violations
✅ No N+1 queries detected: loops in repositories.ts and feed.ts iterate over already-fetched in-memory data, no per-iteration DB calls
⚠️ Coverage gap: src/lib/actions/auto-dispatch-settings.ts has no unit tests (2 exported functions)
⚠️ Coverage gap: src/lib/actions/changelog.ts has no unit tests (3 exported functions)
⚠️ Coverage gap: src/lib/actions/goals.ts has no unit tests (6 exported functions)
⚠️ Coverage gap: src/lib/actions/llm.ts has no unit tests (4 exported functions)
⚠️ Coverage gap: src/lib/actions/repositories.ts has no unit tests (33 exported functions — largest gap)
⚠️ Coverage gap: src/lib/actions/stripe.ts has no unit tests (7 exported functions)
⚠️ Coverage gap: src/lib/actions/weekly-diff.ts has no unit tests (1 exported function)
⚠️ Error handling: src/lib/actions/repositories.ts — 33 async server actions with 0 try/catch blocks; DB failures will propagate as unhandled errors to the client
⚠️ Error handling: src/lib/actions/changelog.ts, auto-dispatch-settings.ts, sync.ts, simulation.ts, feed.ts, weekly-diff.ts — each has 0-1 try/catch for 1-3 DB-touching functions
⚠️ `any` type: src/lib/actions/advisor-accuracy.ts:29 — `let mergedEvents: any[]` should be typed (FeedEvent[] based on context)
⚠️ `any` type: src/lib/github/sync.ts:109 — `githubRepo: any` parameter lacks type annotation
